verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents natural-language AI commands layered on Playwright for act, extract and validate, with selector fallback [skyvern-docs-19]. It says AI is injected into every page interaction [skyvern-docs-5], and its visual element-to-action mapping works on unseen sites without custom code [skyvern-gh-1]. That is the core of described-element action primitives that adapt to UI changes [skyvern-docs-46, skyvern-docs-13]. A hands-on report of it failing to click a tab and a popup on an unfamiliar site [skyvern-comm-2] dents robustness but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: per-primitive docs for click/type on described elements, evidence of how cached deterministic Playwright code [skyvern-docs-35] recovers when selectors or layouts change, and independent corroboration of resilience.
